title: Lodestar admin snippets and replayable safehooks
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary:
Build a lightweight library of safe, parameterized admin snippets ("safehooks") that operators can invoke from the Console or CLI. Each snippet is a small, idempotent, replayable operation (eg. drain node, rotate key reference, cache invalidation) instrumented with pre/post checks and telemetry. The Lodestar library's goal is to reduce time-to-remediate for common incidents while guaranteeing safety through sandbox dry-run, explicit confirmation, RBAC gates, and automatic rollback hooks.

Why this work:
- Many oncall tasks are repetitive but risky when executed ad-hoc; we need curated primitives to reduce blast radius.
- Current runbooks are prose-heavy and difficult to run reliably; converting to typed snippets improves reproducibility and telemetry.
- This enables safer delegation to Tier 1 support and faster remediation without compromising auditability.

Scope / Deliverables:
1) Executable spec for "safehook" format: inputs, output schema, idempotency contract, dry-run mode, explicit confirm mode, and rollback hook reference. (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Lodestar+Safehooks+Spec)
2) Reference implementations (Python + Go) for 6 core snippets: node-drain, prefix-kv-clear, model-cache-evict, ephemeral-restart, audit-log-refresh, kms-ref-rotate.
3) Console integration: quick-launch buttons per snippet with parameter form, preview/dry-run UI, and one-click execution for confirmed runs.
4) Replay sandbox: captured execution traces stored as structured events that can be replayed into an ephemeral sandbox environment for postmortem reproduction.
5) Telemetry & safety: per-snippet SLOs, successful/failed counters, run duration, pre/post invariant checks, and automatic rollback invocation on invariant failure. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/lodestar-snippets
6) RBAC & Audit: Console button respects route-level RBAC and logs full structured audit events to the audit cluster (s3://redwood-audit/lodestar/).
7) Tests & Canary: unit tests for idempotency, integration test harness against a staging cluster, and progressive rollout plan (canary to internal SRE team then broader).

Acceptance criteria:
- All snippets have dry-run and confirm modes and pass idempotency unit tests.
- Console shows preview and requires explicit confirm for destructive ops.
- Every run produces a replay artifact and a structured audit event.
- Telemetry dashboards surface snippet failure rates < 1% in staging and alerts for invariant violations.
- Security review completed and sign-off from security and compliance teams.

Technical notes and design decisions:
- Snippets run inside a constrained operator-worker pod that has ephemeral credentials and limited network egress. This reduces credential exposure compared to running ad-hoc commands from the Console backend.
- We chose an event-first schema for replay artifacts (Proto3 JSON lines) to make deterministic replay easier.
- To enforce idempotency we require each snippet to declare a "safe-key" (eg. a resource UUID) and be implemented as a compare-and-apply sequence when altering state.
- Rollback hooks are optional but recommended; when present, the platform will attempt rollback on invariant failure and mark the run as "rolled_back" in the audit event.

Operational runbook (for SRE):
- How to create a new snippet: 1) open PR with snippet implementation + spec YAML 2) add unit and integration tests 3) create Confluence entry 4) request security review 5) deploy to staging.
- How to execute from Console: open Ops → Lodestar → choose snippet → fill parameters → Preview (dry-run) → Confirm.

Links & artifacts:
- Design spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Lodestar+Safehooks+Spec
- Spike notes (kernel scheduling considerations): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3-Lodestar-Spike
- Draft PR (reference impl): https://github.com/redwood-inference/lodestar/pull/47
- Canary dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/lodestar-snippets
- Incident postmortem that motivated project: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/2025-01-11-kvcache-blast-radius

Rollout plan:
- Week 1 (canary): internal SRE only, 6 snippets in staging, collect replay artifacts.
- Week 2 (expanded): invite two product-support squads to test in staging and runbook walkthroughs.
- Week 3 (pilot): enable non-destructive snippets for Tier 1 in selected orgs.
- Week 4 (general availability): all baked snippets in Console, with training and docs.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: a buggy snippet could cause state corruption. Mitigation: strict code review checklist, dry-run enforcement, and feature-flagged rollout.
- Risk: credential leakage. Mitigation: ephemeral worker pods + constrained creds + KMS logging.
- Risk: replay artifacts contain sensitive data. Mitigation: artifact scrubber pipeline and redact-by-default for PII.
